questions.qtext: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

options.text: Applied ethics: Provides ‘The Golden Rule’ of doing to other as we want them do to us.
Normative ethics: looks for an ideal litmus test of reasonable behavior.

questions.solution:
(b)
Normative theory involves arriving at moral standards that regulate right and wrong conduct. In
a sense, it is a search for an ideal litmus test of proper behavior.

questions.qtext:
Consider the following statements:
1. According to John Stuart Mill, most good produced is absolute morality.
2. According to him, rules of morality are imbibed through years of human experience and they are not flexible.
Which of the above statements is/are INCORRECT?
questions.solution:
(b)
Rules of morality are imbibed through years of human experience and they are flexible. Hence statement 2 is incorrect.

Consider the following statements about Accountability:
1. Accountability do not include being answerable for meeting specific obligations.
2. Praiseworthy or blameworthy means to own the responsibility for the good or bad outcomes.
3. Conscientiousness is the willingness to upgrade their skills and put efforts for assigned work.
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
(b)
Accountability include being answerable for meeting specific obligations. Hence statement 1 is incorrect.

Consider the following statements:
1. Moonlighting refers to paid work that you do in addition to your normal job, especially without telling your employer.
2. The conflict of interest excludes the execution and evaluation of the project.
3. Insider information is typically gained by someone who is working within or close to a listed company.

questions.solution:
(c)
According to the European Federation Consultancy Association (EFCA), the conflict of interest
also includes the execution and evaluation of the project.
